description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing a trivial Ethernet relay, including device handling, frame processing, and debugfs interface.

methods.name: trelay_handle_frame
methods.description: Handles incoming Ethernet frames, forwarding them to the appropriate device if conditions are met.

methods.name: trelay_open
methods.description: Opens the relay device file, setting private data.

methods.name: trelay_do_remove
methods.description: Removes a relay, cleaning up resources and unregistering handlers.

methods.name: trelay_find
methods.description: Finds a relay associated with a given network device.

methods.name: tr_device_event
methods.description: Handles network device events, specifically unregister events to remove relays.

methods.name: trelay_remove_write
methods.description: Handles write operation to trigger relay removal.

methods.name: trelay_remove_release
methods.description: Releases resources when the relay file is closed.

methods.name: trelay_do_add
methods.description: Adds a new relay between two devices.

methods.name: trelay_add_write
methods.description: Handles write operation to add a new relay.

methods.name: trelay_init
methods.description: Initializes the Ethernet relay module, setting up debugfs and notifier.

methods.name: trelay_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the module, unregistering notifier and removing relays.
